name: plugins
one_liner: OpenAI's official set of example add-ons for its Codex coding assistant, showing developers how to build their own add-ons for things like Figma, Notion, and iOS app development.
buyer: No direct buyer — this is a free reference/example repo from OpenAI aimed at developers who want to build Codex plugins, not a product a business would purchase.
business_use_cases: N/A — it's a set of official code examples and templates, not a deployable product.
A tooling vendor (e.g. a project management SaaS) could study these examples to build and publish their own official Codex plugin, increasing their product's reach into AI coding workflows.

money_ideas.idea: If you run a SaaS product, build and publish your own Codex plugin using these examples as a template — it's a distribution channel, not a revenue stream on its own.

steal_this: If you already have a SaaS with an API, spend a weekend turning it into a Codex plugin using this repo's examples as scaffolding — free distribution into every Codex user's workflow.
